name: Exp_Candles_XSmoothed
summary: This EA trades breakouts from smoothed candle high/low channels. It uses a custom Candles_Smoothed indicator to generate smoothed high and low boundaries, then enters long when price closes above the smoothed high plus a breakout level, and enters short when price closes below the smoothed low minus a breakout level. Positions are closed on reverse signals and managed with fixed stop loss and take profit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于平滑K线通道的突破进行交易。使用自定义的Candles_Smoothed指标生成平滑的高低边界，当价格收于平滑高点加上突破水平之上时做多，当价格收于平滑低点减去突破水平之下时做空。反向信号时平仓，并使用固定止损止盈管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于平滑K线通道的突破交易，通过Candles_Smoothed指标对K线高低点进行平滑处理来过滤噪音。入场条件为：当收盘价突破平滑高点加上突破水平(dLevel)时开多仓，当收盘价跌破平滑低点减去突破水平时开空仓。出场条件为：反向突破信号触发平仓（如持多头时收盘价跌破平滑低点减突破水平则平多仓），同时每笔交易设有固定止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)。仓位管理方面，通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算仓位。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，支持按账户余额百分比动态计算交易量。策略运行在H4等较高时间框架上，使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复入场。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is a breakout trading system based on smoothed candle high/low channels, using the Candles_Smoothed indicator to smooth price extremes and filter market noise. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the close price breaks above the smoothed high plus a breakout level (dLevel), and a short position is opened when the close price breaks below the smoothed low minus dLevel. Exit conditions: reverse breakout signals trigger position closure (e.g., a long position is closed when the close falls below the smoothed low minus dLevel), and each trade has a fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a percentage of the deposit. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, supporting dynamic lot calculation based on account balance percentage. The strategy operates on higher timeframes like H4 and uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation occurs only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit ratio or fixed lot; negative = fixed lot

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）
parameters.description_en: Max price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: MA_Phase
parameters.description: 平滑参数（JJMA为-100到+100，VIDIA为CMO周期，AMA为慢速平均周期）
parameters.description_en: Smoothing parameter (JJMA: -100 to +100, VIDIA: CMO period, AMA: slow avg period)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用平滑算法过滤价格噪音，减少虚假突破信号
支持9种平滑方法选择，灵活适应不同市场环境
具有完整的开仓/平仓权限控制，可精细化管理多空方向
使用IsNewBar机制避免同根K线重复计算，逻辑严谨
止损止盈参数明确，风险可控
pros_en: Uses smoothing algorithms to filter price noise, reducing false breakout signals
Supports 9 smoothing methods for flexibility across different market conditions
Full open/close permission controls for both long and short directions
IsNewBar mechanism prevents redundant signal calculation on the same bar
Explicit stop loss and take profit parameters for defined risk management
cons: 突破策略在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和连续亏损
止损1000点和止盈2000点的固定值可能不适合所有品种和波动环境
缺乏对现有持仓的检查，可能重复开仓
没有滑点/点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能不利
回溯搜索方向时从SignalBar遍历所有K线，效率低下且逻辑不够清晰
cons_en: Breakout strategies prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Fixed 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP may not suit all instruments and volatility environments
Lacks existing position checking, potentially leading to duplicate entries
No spread filter, which can be disadvantageous in high-spread conditions
The loop searching from SignalBar through all bars is inefficient and logically unclear
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
增加点差过滤和市场波动率自适应的止损止盈机制
improvements_en: Add position checking logic to avoid duplicate entries when same-direction positions already exist
Add spread filtering and volatility-adaptive stop loss/take profit mechanism

risk_points: 突破策略在震荡市中可能频繁触发止损导致连续亏损
缺乏持仓检查可能导致同方向重复开仓，放大风险敞口
固定止损止盈不适应不同市场波动环境
risk_points_en: Breakout strategy may trigger stop losses frequently in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lack of position checking may cause duplicate same-direction entries, amplifying risk exposure
Fixed stop loss/take profit does not adapt to varying market volatility conditions
